title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka chooses her dream, the Japanese Derby, over her competition with her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she makes her entrance, the crowd erupts in cheers that are a mix of anticipation and disdain. Her opponents also give her cold stares.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Vodka shrugs it all off and runs in the race she's always dreamed of in order to show everyone her true way of life.
